title: Planet Tweaks V2.4.8 ULTRA — Next-Gen Esports Crosshair Studio, Mouse Color Canvas & Mongraal 0-Ping Overhaul
releaseNotes: Next-Gen Esports Crosshair Designer Studio: Interactive mouse color spectrum canvas with click & drag tracking, custom HEX input codes, fine-tuned RGB sliders, and esports favorite palettes. Conditional Outline Engine: Dynamically locks outline color picker and thickness controls when high-contrast outlines are toggled off. Custom Loadout Persistence: Name your custom reticles, save them permanently to disk, and switch between pro presets (Peterbot Micro Dot, Mongraal Classic Cross, TenZ Cyan Precision, Clix Shotgun Circle, ScreaM T-Shape, Void Diamond, etc.) with 1-click loading. 12 Pro Reticle Shapes: Full support for Cross, Dot, T-Shape, Circle, Circle Dot, Diamond, Box, Chevron, X-Cross, Sniper, Triangle, and 8-Point Star with 0°–360° free rotation. Mongraal 0-Ping Pack: Upgraded esports network engine eliminating Nagle delay, forcing 1:1 instantaneous TCP ACK frequency, and unlocking CTCP congestion provider.
